scope: HIP native-fallback inference RMSNorm; BF16 input/weight; widths 128/2048, ranks 2/3, 1..512 rows, eps 1e-6; preserve native FP32 cast/square/mean/add/rsqrt; fuse only two FP32 multiplies and BF16 store with fp fusion disabled
numerical_gate: exact BF16 native parity plus independent CPU FP64 relative L2 <=0.001; model IDs and logprobs retain existing gates
fallback: unsupported semantics retain original dispatch; stale source/runtime/model/device requires omission of the module override and environment
rollback: omit WORKSTATION_RMSNORM_EPILOGUE and the dedicated layernorm module mount; start a fresh native-RMSNorm process with the selected verified GEMM/MoE tables
cache_reuse: fresh owner boot/runtime/source/model/device identity; private bounded cache per startup
